title: Guarded install in the worktree procedure
goal: `deps:install` refuses `npm ci` through a symlinked node_modules
acceptance: `core/tools/install-deps.mjs` refuses to run when `node_modules` is a symlink (message names the fix) and otherwise runs `npm ci`; `deps:install` is in `package-scripts.json`
The parallel-work procedure says to run `npm run deps:install` in every worktree and never to link `node_modules`
Failing test committed first: a fixture with a symlinked node_modules expects exit 1 against an empty tool; the change never edits that test to pass
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: The report's 1 h plus a symlink fixture. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
